metadata.deck: standard 52-card deck without replacement; discards never return
metadata.success: contains a target core; targets overlap; straight flush includes royal flush
metadata.k_definition: piecewise-linear inverse of exact direct-draw success probabilities
metadata.sampling_intervals: individual approximate 95% normal intervals for a bounded conditional-success mean; exclude policy suboptimality and rounding
metadata.policy: At each non-final step, maximize conditional probability of containing the target after a hypothetical future draw of d + round((t-1)*min(5,m-reserve)) cards. The held cards plus future drawn cards are used as a lookahead surrogate, not as actual accumulated inventory. Choose reserve on separate pilot samples. On the final step, maximize exact one-discard success probability over every legal action. Straight flush lookahead sums suit-wise union probabilities; at the final step the possible two-suit intersection for m=10 is subtracted exactly.
metadata.validation: Exact no-discard DP vs independent integer combinatorial baseline; all 8 last-step optimizers vs physical-card enumeration on 15 reduced decks; multi-step rank/suit recursion vs independent physical-card enumeration on 4 reduced decks.
